summary: Known issue: 2.4 accepted encrypted SAML private keys silently, but 2.6 doesn't support them; replace them with unencrypted keys before upgrading or the SAML authenticator isn't migrated and must be recreated.
questions: SAML authenticator missing after upgrade to 2.6
Are encrypted SAML private keys supported in 2.6?
How do I avoid SAML migration errors?
